prompts.title: Dark Aesthetic Birthday Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image strictly as the facial identity reference only. Ignore the original pose, clothing, framing, lighting, expression, and background. Create a premium, ultra-realistic professional birthday studio portrait matching the composition and atmosphere described below.

IDENTITY LOCK
The subject must remain clearly recognizable as the person in the uploaded reference.
Preserve accurately:
facial structure, jawline, cheekbones, chin
eye shape, spacing, eyebrows, nose, lips
natural skin tone and realistic skin texture
hairline and natural hairstyle characteristics
beard/moustache only if present in the reference
glasses only if present in the reference
Do not beautify, reshape, stylize, age, or alter the face. Avoid an exaggerated smile that could change facial identity. Use a subtle, relaxed, confident expression with lips naturally closed or a very slight soft smile.

SUBJECT & POSE
Show the subject seated comfortably and confidently in a large luxurious black velvet armchair with deep cushioning, broad upholstered arms, subtle channel detailing, and an elegant brushed-gold metal frame.
Pose:
seated naturally in the center-right portion of the composition
torso facing mostly toward the camera
relaxed upright posture, slightly leaning back into the chair
shoulders open and natural
both forearms resting comfortably on the armrests
hands relaxed with realistic finger anatomy
legs naturally separated
feet firmly positioned on the floor
calm direct eye contact with the camera
The pose should look like a professionally directed birthday portrait, not a corporate headshot or stiff catalogue pose.

CLOTHING
Dress the subject in an elegant all-black monochromatic outfit:
premium black button-up shirt
soft natural fabric with realistic folds
collar casually open by one or two buttons
sleeves neatly rolled to approximately the forearms
tailored black trousers
black socks
polished black leather lace-up dress shoes
The clothing should feel sophisticated, modern, luxurious, and appropriate for an upscale birthday celebration.

BIRTHDAY STUDIO SET
Create a dark luxury photography studio with a sophisticated black-and-champagne-gold birthday theme.
Background:
matte charcoal-black / deep black paneled wall
elegant decorative wall moulding
subtle architectural depth
no distracting furniture or unrelated decorations
Behind the subject, prominently display a warm glowing birthday sign.
The text must read exactly:
Happy
Birthday
NAME
in a large elegant handwritten cursive neon-style script, glowing in warm champagne-gold light.
Keep it centered beneath “Happy Birthday,” similar in prominence to a professionally designed birthday backdrop.

BALLOONS & DECORATION
Arrange sophisticated balloons around both sides of the scene:
glossy black balloons
pearl/champagne balloons
different natural sizes and heights
thin elegant gold balloon strings
curled metallic champagne-gold ribbons
Keep the balloons mostly around the outer edges so they frame the subject without covering the face, chair, birthday lettering, or cake.
Add a few tasteful curled ribbons and small pieces of metallic gold-and-black confetti on the floor. Decoration should feel intentional and premium, not crowded or childish.

BIRTHDAY CAKE
Place a small elegant round side table on the lower-left side of the subject, positioned beside the chair.
Table:
slim black frame
refined circular champagne-gold tabletop or gold trim
luxury minimalist styling
On the table place a compact premium birthday cake:
cylindrical black cake
smooth professional finish
elegant champagne-gold drip decoration
subtle fine gold detailing near the base
several slim lit birthday candles arranged neatly across the top
The candle flames should create tiny warm highlights while remaining realistic.

COMPOSITION
Vertical 4:5 portrait orientation.
Use a polished full-body editorial composition:
subject fully visible from head to shoes
chair fully readable
shoes not cropped
comfortable headroom
birthday lettering clearly visible above and slightly behind the subject
cake clearly visible at lower left
balloons framing both sides
balanced amount of negative space
no elements awkwardly cut by the image borders
Place the subject slightly right of center so the cake and decorations balance the left side of the frame.
Camera approximately at seated chest/eye level, with a natural professional portrait perspective.

LIGHTING
Use realistic high-end studio photography lighting rather than artificial CGI illumination.
Lighting setup:
large soft key light from front-left at approximately 45°
gentle fill from camera-right
subtle warm rim/separation light around the hair and shoulders
warm glow from the birthday sign
soft candlelight accents
controlled highlights on balloons and gold metal
natural shadow falloff beneath the chair and subject
deep blacks while retaining fabric texture and shadow detail
Skin must retain realistic pores, fine texture, natural tonal variation, and believable highlights.

CAMERA & IMAGE QUALITY
Photographed as if using a professional full-frame camera with an 85mm portrait lens around f/2.8–f/4, ISO 100, high dynamic range, accurate focus and realistic depth of field.
The face and eyes must be extremely sharp, while the background receives only subtle natural depth separation.
Premium professional birthday photography, realistic lens rendering, finely resolved hair strands, detailed fabric, realistic hands, natural skin, physically believable balloons, accurate reflections, premium materials, subtle cinematic contrast, clean highlight roll-off, and extremely high facial detail.
The final image should resemble a real luxury birthday studio photoshoot produced by an experienced portrait photographer and professional set designer, not an AI-generated birthday poster.
